In case you missed it, here’s this weeks episode of Stuff Keeps Happening!

youtu.be/uSs6vL1d27o
If I were hypothetically making a tier list video of all the anime I’ve recently been watching, should I include movies or just series? Seems hard to compare aside from series that *have a movie*
Unfortunately, London is infamous for having virtually no options for theater, art, and food 😔

Today's episode of Stuff Keeps Happening is up on YouTube!

A look at Microsoft Copilot and the myriad L's it's been taking, as well as updates on the war in Iran and the Artemis II launch.

Watch the full thing here: youtu.be/uSs6vL1d27o
The bug in the corner desperately trying to avoid getting squished
Fucking wild to watch a world leader publicly go from "we already won" to "get your own oil" to several shifting and vague apocalyptic threats for the Strait to reopen over the course of like a week

Geodude is a walking green flag 

Or whatever he does since he doesn't have legs

GYRO PLATTER

SPICY SAUCE

RICE
From tomorrow's episode, pretty emblematic of the current state of everything

I made a request to open the fuckin' Strait

But Stuff still Happened
Me every morning and every night

Heads up that I’m gonna be making some significant changes to my merch store Soon™️ so if you’ve been eyeing something, now’s the time to grab it

Unfortunately the denim jacket supplier has discontinued the blanks, which is sad because that jacket ruled

Browse stuff here: merchfrom.dev
To be clear this list will include the single best piece of fiction ever written, “The Other World's Books Depend on the Bean Counter”

Been watching a ton of anime recently and might have to make a tier list video for the stuff I've watched so far

It's all S+ so far as a baseline so it'll just be a matter of additional pluses 

Well, mostly.

Pam Bondi is apparently out as AG

Perhaps she can take up a new career as a defendant at The Hague

I wrote a bit about Microsoft's generational run of pushing unnecessary—sometimes dangerous—features into their core products and what the impact of that has been

Read it here: www.skh.news/microslop-au...
I don't have speech patterns I just have a vast library of vocal stims and a shuffle button
I like how some designer at apple was like "okay and when they're in the edit mode for the home screen then everything gets all wiggly jiggly y'know?"
